name: engine_derating_iso3046
title: Engine derating according to ISO 3046/1 (ambient pressure and temperature)
summary: Power correction of an engine between the ISO 3046/1 reference conditions and the site conditions: correction factor K from the dry atmospheric pressure, absolute intake-air temperature and coolant temperature ratios (factor a, exponents m, n, s of the ISO table), derating factor alpha = K - 0.7*(1-K)*(1/eta_m - 1), site shaft power. Two exercises: naturally aspirated Diesel (372 kW on site) and supercharged aftercooled engine (1000 kW catalogue).

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (exercise 1 is the stored run): the runnable variant engine_derating_iso3046_coolsolve.eescode agrees on all 14 common variables, max rel. diff 3.9e-6 (alpha); the 3 other stored values (altitude_x, q, Test_x) are stale leftovers of exercise 2 and of the commented Test block, absent from the stored run
verification.notes: Unit system of the source: SI MASS DEG KPA K KJ, converted by hand to SI MASS DEG PA C J. Comparison with compare_solution.py --ees-units.
